enum.name: #pck-l18
enum.doc: l18 with bit 1 = "both formats are f16 or f32": it prints rint then, scale otherwise.

bitset.name: #dst.ix
bitset.doc: Indexed: bank[idx<k>+off], number = ib << (w - 2) | (k - 1) << (w - 3) | off, w = 7, or 6 under format select.

bitset.name: #dst.g
bitset.doc: Extension bank 1: g<n> is n + 0x40; a number below 64 is c<n>.

bitset.name: #dst.idx
bitset.doc: Not halved under format select: a bare .f16 (or .c10) only sets bit 6: idx16.f16 is number 16 with bit 6 set.

bitset.name: #src.c
bitset.doc: c<n> is n (0-63); g<n> is n + 0x40 on the same bank.

bitset.name: #instruction
bitset.doc: h27-31 (bits 59-63) is the hardware class; each class splits further on its own sub-op bits.

bitset.name: #alu-float
bitset.doc: Fields common to hw 0, 2, 3 and 4 (the float classes).

bitset.name: #float-mod
bitset.doc: Source modifiers: h3/h4 = -src2 / |src2|, h5/h6 = -src1 / |src1|.

bitset.name: fdpc
bitset.doc: fdp plus a clip-plane result cp0-7 in l15-17, l14 set.

bitset.name: #float-ddp
bitset.doc: fddp/fddpc: two dot products, the second into i0/i1 (h19), so the destination has no extension bit.

bitset.name: fddpc
bitset.doc: Clip planes in h3-5 and h6-8, no source modifiers. h8 is also inc2: the word holds the OR of the two, so inc2 is folded into CPB here.

bitset.name: #float-scalar
bitset.doc: One source, in the src1 slot. h7 = F16 source (h3 picks the half), h8 = C10 source (h3-4 the channel), h2 = F16 destination. h21 = rcnt: h12-15 is count - 1 when set, else a write mask.

bitset.name: fmad16
bitset.doc: Every operand is a whole register holding an F16 pair. Swizzles: src0 h9-10, src1 h13 + h18, src2 h21-22; repeat 1-2 in h12, with explicit increments. No end bit.

bitset.name: #move
bitset.doc: h8-10 picks the form; h21 rcnt, h12-15 count - 1 or write mask.

bitset.name: mov
bitset.doc: src0's field is 0; src2 holds the unused-source pattern (#0).

bitset.name: #movc
bitset.doc: movc.<cond>.<type> d, s0, s1, s2: d = test(s0) ? s1 : s2.

bitset.name: #op0xf3
bitset.doc: op0xf3 (writes an output; never emitted by the compiler). f1_1 = h7, f1_26 = h22, a3f = h5-6.

bitset.name: pck
bitset.doc: pck.<dst>.<src> d, s1[.l<n>], s2[.l<n>]. The enabled bytes of dmask, low to high, take src1, src2, src1, src2.

bitset.name: #test
bitset.doc: The ALU op (l14-19) runs, and the condition tests its result: cond = sign (h10-11) | zero (h8-9) << 2 | AND (h7) << 4. l20 says there is a destination; without one the dst field holds the raw value nodst (default 0x280).

bitset.name: #bitwise
bitset.doc: An immediate src2 (bank 2 + extension) is 16 bits: l0-6, l14-20, h4-5; rot (h6-10) rotates it left, inv (h11) inverts it.

bitset.name: rlp
bitset.doc: rlp dst, src1, pN: the predicate in l14-15. src2's slot read as one 10-bit value is unused2, 0x300 (the unused pattern) by default.

bitset.name: #smp
bitset.doc: smp.<dim>[.bias|.lod|.grad][.f16|.c10][.pcf|.pcf16][.rdata|.rinfo] dst, coord, state[, lod]. h12-15 is the write mask (or count - 1 with rcnt); ret is ORed into its bits 2-3, so the text's mask is bits 0-1 when ret is set.

bitset.name: #ldst
bitset.doc: Address mode h10-11, size h4-5, base in the src0 slot (bank h2, extension h18), offset in src1, range (ld) or data (st) in src2.

bitset.name: st
bitset.doc: No destination; h0 = f3_13 instead of a DRC; h22 = nosched.

bitset.name: #eld
bitset.doc: eld.<d|q> dst, src1, src0, #imm11, src2. The immediate takes h5-11 (low 7 bits) and h16-19 (high 4), so no source has an extension bit.

bitset.name: #flow
bitset.doc: Flow control: op in h6-8, predicate h24-26.

bitset.name: ba
bitset.doc: Absolute target: the instruction index from the USE code base.

bitset.name: br
bitset.doc: Relative target: this instruction + n, signed 18 bits.

bitset.name: setl
bitset.doc: Set the link address from the src1 slot.

bitset.name: savl
bitset.doc: Save the link address to the destination slot (no extension bit).

bitset.name: nop
bitset.doc: h23 sync-start, h18 end, l0 = f2_26, l1 = f3_5.

bitset.name: op0x98
bitset.doc: h6-8 = 0, h9 = 1, h19 = 1; no arguments; meaning unknown.

bitset.name: smoa
bitset.doc: Four signed 10-bit values and four 2-bit modes.

bitset.name: #moe12
bitset.doc: smr / smbo / imo: four 12-bit values.

bitset.name: smlsi
bitset.doc: Per operand (dst, src0, src1, src2) an 8-bit value; its flag (h3/h2/h1/h0) set makes it a swizzle, clear a signed increment. lim0-2 are stored as given (multiples of 4).

bitset.name: #moe-reg
bitset.doc: Register forms of ops 0-3: values from the src1 and src2 slots.

bitset.name: setfc
bitset.doc: a0 (l0) = the efo F16 enable (off at program start), a1 (l8) = the C10 enable of the color classes (on at program start).

bitset.name: op0xfd
bitset.doc: dst in the destination slot, n h11-14; meaning unknown.

bitset.name: emit
bitset.doc: All three source slots exist (src0: bank h2, extension h19). n = h0-1 + h9; the 14-bit immediate is l22-27, h3-8, h22-23.

bitset.name: limm
bitset.doc: dst = the destination slot; the 32-bit immediate is l0-20 (bits 0-20), h4-8 (21-25), h12-17 (26-31); predicate h9-11.

bitset.name: #ldrstr
bitset.doc: addr = the src2 slot; as an immediate it has 14 bits, the high 7 in l14-20. h19 = str.

bitset.name: #vis
bitset.doc: src0 (bank h2, extension h19), src1, src2; int-source-select flags sel36 h3, sel37 h4, sel34 h5; h23 = syncs.

bitset.name: ptoff
bitset.doc: pcoeff's op with h15 set and every source field 0.

bitset.name: atst8
phas.i
bitset.doc: pc l0-17 (absolute), temps4 h0-7 (temporaries / 4), wait h8-10, rate h11-12, sel43 h13, end h19.

bitset.name: #int
bitset.doc: Shared by hw 10-19 and 1a: short predicate h25-26, skipinv h23, nosched h22, end h18; generic dst, src1 and src2 slots.

bitset.name: sop2
bitset.doc: dst.rgb = (src1 * c1) cop (src2 * c2), dst.a = (src1.a * a1) aop (src2.a * a2). No src0: l14-20 hold the alpha controls.

bitset.name: sopwm
bitset.doc: dst = (src1 * c1) cop (src2 * c2) per byte, with a write mask whose bits 0-3 are stored in h12, h13, h14, h11. No repeat.

bitset.name: #sop3
bitset.doc: dst, src0 (r/pa), src1, src2; c1/c2 selects h6-8 + h24, h3-5 + h15; h21 picks the color op, h10 the coissued alpha op. No repeat.

bitset.name: #dot
bitset.doc: h24 = 4-vector; h5 = a coissued alpha op with src0 (dot3s/dot4s); cs h7-8 color scale; src1/src2 complement h11/h15.

bitset.name: #ima8
bitset.doc: dst = c0 * c1 + c2 per channel, alpha = a0 * s1a + s2a; src0 (r/pa) negate h3.

bitset.name: ima16
bitset.doc: dst = src0 * src1 + src2, 16-bit; src0 r/pa.

bitset.name: imae
bitset.doc: dst = src0 * src1 + src2: 16x16 + 32 with carry; src0 r/pa.

bitset.name: ima32
bitset.doc: dst = src0 * src1 + src2, 32-bit; the high word to i0-i2 (hi), carry in from i0-i2 (cin); src0 r/pa/o/sa with extension h15.

bitset.name: op1adrc
bitset.doc: dest r/pa (h7), raw number; drc h0; sources src1, src2. Never emitted for SGX545; the operation is unknown.

bitset.name: #hw16-noext1
bitset.doc: #int's fields without src1's extension bit (h17 = 0).

bitset.name: adif
bitset.doc: Probably |src1 - src2|; no src0.

bitset.name: adifsum
bitset.doc: adif + src0 (r/pa): h6 set; s0f13 h15.

bitset.name: op16s1
bitset.doc: Repeat h12-13 only. Operation unknown.

bitset.name: #ssum16
bitset.doc: src0 has no bank bits: its number (l14-20) is read in src1's bank; src1 has no extension bit.

bitset.name: ssum16i
bitset.doc: src0 is an internal register, its number raw in l14-20; no src1.

bitset.name: firv
bitset.doc: src0's number (l14-20) is read in src1's bank. shift is 5 bits: 0-1 h10-11, 2-3 h14-15, 4 h24 (printed raw). Repeat h12-13.

bitset.name: firh
bitset.doc: The dest is an internal register, its number raw in l21-27; shift bits 2-3 move to h0-1; repeat h12-14; h19 = f2_27.

bitset.name: efo
bitset.doc: Two multipliers and two adders feeding i0/i1: d (h20-21) picks what the destination gets, i (h18-19) the internal writes, a (h16-17) the adder inputs, m (h14-15) the multiplier inputs. Short predicate h24-25; no end bit. Operands follow the F16 format control.

bitset.name: fdual
bitset.doc: Two ops in one word: the primary (pri = h18 | h19 << 1 | h26 << 2) on dst (no extension bit) and the slots, the secondary (sec, h6-9) into i0-i2: sd = h5 | h13 << 1, sb = h14-15, sc = h10 | h21 << 1; for a mov secondary msrc = h14 | h15 << 1 | h21 << 2 instead. No end bit.
